frames.title: Right now — learning in public
frames.body: Building AI-flavored tools, breaking things on purpose, and writing down what happened. This portfolio is the log file.

frames.title: First real projects — the phase where tutorials end
frames.body: Moved from following tutorials to shipping things nobody asked for but I needed. Learned that deployment is a feature, not an afterthought.

frames.title: Going deeper — data structures, systems, debugging
frames.body: Stopped copying code and started reading it. Learned to love the debugger and the error message that finally makes sense at 2am.

frames.title: The first line of code
frames.body: Where it started: curiosity, a blank file, and a program that printed my own name. Nothing has been the same since.
